name: Electrolysis of Water Apparatus (Voltameter)
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Chemistry Ch 1 Activity 1.7 (Fig 1.6) laboratory-grade Electrolysis of Water apparatus. Features dual presentation collections: Electrolysis_Apparatus_Full (complete setup with translucent polypropylene mug, inverted borosilicate test tubes over graphite carbon electrodes with 2:1 stoichiometric gas headspace displacement of H2 vs O2, acidified water with bubble effervescence, 6V DC battery pack, plug key switch, and alligator clip copper wiring) and Electrolysis_Apparatus_Section (longitudinal cutaway through mug revealing internal rubber stopper seating, borehole water seal, graphite rod contact, 2:1 gas volumetric calipers, 2H2O -> 2H2 + O2 equation plaque, and gas identification test badges with popping flame and rekindling ember).
simplifications: Electrolyte solution shown with subtle aqueous blue-green tint.
Gas bubbles depicted at electrode tips and tube headspaces.
Stoichiometric 2:1 volume displacement modeled directly at test tube menisci.

materials.look: Borosilicate glass inverted test tubes and vessel body
Porous black carbon graphite electrode rods
Transparent liquid electrolyte with subtle meniscus
Refractive micro-bubbles of H2 and O2 gases
